key_points: Q3 2026 earnings and revenue beat lifted sentiment, a genuine fundamental positive.
Jefferies initiated coverage with a Buy, citing AI data-center fiber demand and optical scaling into 2028 — validates the growth thesis.
Multibillion-dollar long-term optical agreements with Verizon and AT&T reinforce revenue visibility.
Fund flows positive (Capital Group ETF buying ~$108M), but ETF/dividend-focused pieces are largely noise.
Offsetting risk: AI/chip complex volatility (Nvidia selloff, China export concerns) could pressure GLW near term despite company-specific strength.
